plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan critique approved the architecture with changes. Concern 1 fixed by adding explicit wallBreached/breachEntered route latches. Concern 2 fixed by serializing and comparing map config, spawn, rooms, tile flags, and terrain across windowed/headless paths. Concern 3 fixed by deriving AI locations from buildFloor5MapConfig manifest plumbing. Concern 4 fixed for RNG streams by deriving runtime keys from manifest labels; checkpointCount remains validated manifest geometry for later slice expansion and is intentionally not gameplay-authoritative in Slice 1. Concern 5 reviewed and deferred: DEFEAT uses existing ScenarioRunOutcome taxonomy only for abnormal command-post destruction in this skeleton; later loss taxonomy should widen with live damage gameplay.

code_review.notes: Round 1 found no code/runtime/security issues. The single finding was the in-progress ledger missing code_review and independent_grade entries; resolved by recording this code_review stage and continuing to independent_grade before final validation.

independent_grade.notes: The change cleanly implements the Floor 5 siege foundation without regressions. It preserves layer boundaries, avoids non-deterministic calls, includes required test coverage (unit and headless), properly wires the new generator, and correctly handles its state configuration. No correctness or architecture issues were found.
